steps.title: Foundational STEM Review for Grade 11
steps.completion_criteria: Successful completion and evaluation of Foundational STEM Review for Grade 11 requirements.
steps.description: Consolidate core concepts in mathematics, physics, and basic computing to bridge gaps from the General stream. Focus on algebra, geometry, and introductory physics principles while establishing a disciplined study rhythm suited to an investigative learner. Completion equips you with the quantitative base required for senior‑year honors and university prerequisites, and sets the tone for systematic research habits.
learning_objectives: Apply algebraic techniques to solve real‑world problems
Explain fundamental physics concepts of force and motion
Write and debug basic Python programs for mathematical visualization

macro_view.strategic_context: Establishing a solid STEM foundation early prevents future bottlenecks in advanced coursework and ensures you meet the University of Manchester's academic thresholds. This phase transforms raw curiosity into structured analytical ability, laying the groundwork for honors‑level projects. By mastering fundamentals now, you free cognitive bandwidth for later research-intensive milestones.
